name: shopkit
description: The e-commerce design system you can copy-paste. HTML + CSS (SCSS) with token-driven runtime theming, dark mode, and multi-brand.

scripts.build: sass scss/shopkit.scss dist/shopkit.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && sass scss/shopkit.scss dist/shopkit.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run size && npm run react:build && npm run parity
